allowed.reason: Issue 592. This is `animation: gds-chat-typing 1s infinite`, and `@keyframes gds-chat-typing` is defined NOWHERE — GDS ships zero @keyframes, so the declaration animates nothing and the indicator renders three static dots. Mapping 1s to the nearest step (360ms) would be meaningless work on a dead reference, and #584 §6 excludes adding keyframes. Allowlisted until #592 decides whether to define the animation (with a scale value and a reduced-motion guard) or delete the declaration.
